title: Heartland Rock
style: melodic, bright, classic, electric guitars, rock, classic 80s rock
lyrics:
Verse 1
Packed our bags, left the keys on the floor
no more maps, we’re chasing something more.
City lights fading in the rearview
just me and you, and the sky so blue.
Verse 2
Radio’s loud, and your hand’s in mine
every mile feels like a sign.
We’ve got no plan, just open roads
but love like ours always knows.
Chorus
Highways and hearts
we’re burning like stars.
With you by my side
I don’t need to hide.
We’ve got nothing but truth
and a love that won’t lose.
Highways and hearts
we’re chasing the spark.
Verse 3
Mountains rise, oceans call our name
every sunset feels the same.
We’re not running, we’re just free
you and me, wild and endlessly.
Bridge (guitar solo builds)
Let the world say we’re crazy
we’ll prove ‘em wrong daily.
No fear, no doubt
just love screaming out.
Final Chorus (with soaring guitars)
Highways and hearts
we’re burning like stars.
With you by my side
I don’t need to hide.
We’ve got nothing but truth
and a love that won’t lose.
Highways and hearts
forever’s where we start.
